name: Valdehúncar (Spain)
description: Chequy of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdehúncar (a chequy field above rushes and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valdehúncar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdehúncar arms — chequy above rushes and waves
